title: Music Pig
description: Ever wanted a pig that serenades you with Aria Math on violin? No? Well now you have one anyway.
body:
# Music Pig :3

Music Pig is a small cozy mod that adds a calm and warm atmosphere to the world. It introduces a violin that the player can use to always play the same track, _**Aria Math**_, creating a relaxing background while playing. 

If you hit a pig while holding the violin, it also starts playing music, adding a simple, cute, and slightly magical feeling that makes the world feel more alive!


![Me playing with pig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f452d5b171c6facb93558762c53f6dee095686b4.png)
